Finance Act, 1994: s.65(31) – Service Tax – Definition of “consulting engineer” u/s. 65(31) of the Act – Whether ‘body corporate’ is covered within its sweep prior to 2005 amendment – Held: Even before the 2005 amendment, the “body corporate” – Even in s.3(42) of the General Clauses Act, 1897, the word “person” includes any company or association or body of individuals, whether incorporated or not – Therefore, there is no logic and/or reason to exclude a” body
